nodes.title: LC Flux 3 Klein AnyPaint 🩹

en.text:
## LC Flux 3 Klein AnyPaint 🩹
---

@[card: Follow me](https://civitai.com/user/lonecatone23)

@[card: Follow me](https://www.instagram.com/synth.studio.models/)

@[card: Get my stuff here](https://github.com/lonecatone23)

@[card: Get my models here](https://huggingface.co/Lonecatone23)

@[card: Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

### This is many hours of work. If you enjoy it, please 👍 like, 💬 comment, and feel free to ⚡ tip 😉

---

### 🛑🚫✋ Read this first
- Flux 3 Klein inpaint and outpaint with an **Outpaint LoRA**
- 📂 Put the LoRA in your loras folder. Get it [Here](https://huggingface.co/ausboss/FLUX-3-Image-Klein-Outpaint-LoRA).

```
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    └── loras/
        └── Flux3/
            └── Utility/
                └── flux-3-image-klein-outpaint.safetensors
```

- Flux 3 Klein is gated. Accept the FLUX Community License on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy) first, or nothing downloads.
- Use **Flux 3 Klein (Distilled)**. 16 steps, euler / simple, cfg 1. The LoRA was trained on Base but made for Distilled.

**LC Flux 3 Klein AnyPaint 🩹**
- **prompt:** describe the whole finished picture, not just the change. "An old fisherman in a yellow raincoat on a pier", not "yellow raincoat". The node puts the LoRA's instruction in front for you.
- 💡 "Remove the car" style prompts leave a flat blob. Describe what should be there instead.
- **lora_strength:** 1.5 is AusBoss's pick. 1.0 slips more often on big extensions.
- **crop_to_mask** on (inpaint): small areas get redrawn in their own crop at full resolution. Off (outpaint): the whole picture.
- **inpaint_resolution:** 1024 is about 1 MP, which is what the LoRA was tested at.
- ⚠️ Your picture should cover about half the canvas or more. For a bigger extension, run it again on the result.
- **composite keep original:** only the painted area is pasted back. **raw:** the model's whole redraw.

---

***"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"***- Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*

nodes.title: How to use

en.text:
- Flux 3 Klein inpaint and outpaint with **AusBoss's Outpaint LoRA**, done the way it was trained.

- **[FLUX 3 Image Klein Outpaint LoRA](https://huggingface.co/ausboss/FLUX-3-Image-Klein-Outpaint-LoRA)**

---

### ✋ How to use

### 🎚️Choose inpaint or outpaint from the toggle. 
- ⚠️ both will populate, but only the one selected will work

**Inpaint 🖌️**

- Run once so the picture shows on **LC Create Mask**, then paint over what you want changed 
   - set pencil or point mode. 
   - block on empty mask prevents it from processing until a mask is drawn

**Outpaint & Rotate**

- Drag the edges out and rotate the image 
- Write the prompt for the **whole** wider picture, including what fills the new sides.

**Prompting ✍🏼**
- base vs anypaint prompt
   - if you are just outpainting, base prompt works okay
   - for inpainting, you must use the anypaint prompt
- 💡instead of *"show her legs"* when extending the image downward, write **"pink haired woman sitting on a couch wearing a pink sweater and white lace panties"**  


---

**Settings worth touching**
- **boundary_px:** 32 is the trained value. Raise it if a seam ever shows.
- **padding (inpaint):** more = the model sees more of the scene around the mask.
- **lora_strength:** 1.5. Off works too, but the picture tends to shift.
